messages:
maria: Customer ACME is seeing intermittent 502s + p95 latency flares on /v1/generate since ~yesterday evening. They sent three example request IDs: 01H8A6-req_0a12, 01H8A6-req_0a13, 01H8A6-req_0b99. Payloads are large (~1200 input tokens) and responses ~350 tokens. Asking for repro steps and a debug bundle — can we collect logs + a curl they can run to reproduce?
ajay: Thanks — can you paste the exact x-request-id header values and one full example curl (incl headers + body)? Also need the concurrency/profile they were hitting (RPS, bursts) and whether the client did retries.
maria: From the customer (copied): x-request-id: 01H8A6-req_0a12, 01H8A6-req_0a13, 01H8A6-req_0b99. They said steady ~45 RPS with short bursts to ~120 RPS for ~20–40s. No client retries. Sample minimal curl they sent: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'X-Request-ID: 01H8A6-req_0a12' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","max_tokens":350,"prompt":"<customer prompt here>"}'```
tom: Can we also get the exact input token counts per example prompt? If the prompt is ~1200 tokens that stresses KV cache and batching. We should capture runtime trace IDs and kernel selection logs for those request IDs.
sarah: I'll kick off a debug bundle collection. @debug-bot / @ops can you run a collect-debug for those x-request-ids and include per-route histograms, GPU mem + fragmentation stats, kernel selection traces, and the loadgen profile? Preferred repro replay: 50 concurrent connections targeting bursts up to 120 RPS, max_tokens 350, repeat the customer token distribution.
debug-bot: Started debug collection for traces [01H8A6-req_0a12,01H8A6-req_0a13,01H8A6-req_0b99]. ETA ~6 minutes. Uploading to s3://support-debug/redwood/acme/1792001234/.
ajay: For local repro, run something like (use payload.json that matches their prompt/token distribution): ```for i in $(seq 1 1000); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Request-ID: local-repro-$i" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @payload.json & done;``` Capture client-side timings (ttfb, total). Also include system-level metrics: netstat, iostat, nvidia-smi loop during replay.
maria: I've asked ACME to upload payload.json and a representative prompt set (5 prompts). They responded with token lengths: [200, 400, 1200, 600, 240]. I'll attach when available.
tom: Once the bundle is up I'll run a replay on staging with both rwd-3b float16 and rwd-3b-quant to see if tail latency correlates with kernel fallback or quantized path. If 502s line up with CPU fallback / OOM windows we'll have a smoking gun in kernel-selection and OOM traces.
sarah: debug-bot uploaded the bundle: s3://support-debug/redwood/acme/1792001234/ (contains nginx access+error logs, runtime traces, kernel-selection logs, batch histograms, KV cache stats). I've opened ticket INF-3241 and asked Dedicated infra to watch for GPU mem fragmentation during the replay window. Maria — once ACME drops payloads, we can schedule the staged replay. :white_check_mark:
